video_title: We get HEATED if the 2020 Lakers would WIPE THE FLOOR with the 2012 Miami Heat 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson and Charlie Villanueva debate if the 2020 Lakers were a stacked team
quotes.excerpt: I don't think this team is that stacked, bro. Okay, let's go over this list.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: No, this team is not that stacked, bro. Okay, let's go over this list.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: We got LeBron James, Anthony Davis, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Rajon Rondo, Kyle Kuzma, Danny Green, Markieff Morris, Alex Caruso, Dwight Howard, Quinn Cook, JR Smith, Jared Dudley. There's a plethora of guys that started on multiple teams.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson and Charlie Villanueva debate if the 2020 Lakers could beat the 2013 Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: The Miami Heat team couldn't beat that 2020 Lakers team. What?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The Miami Heat team couldn't beat that 2020 Lakers team. What?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: What? They could? Fuck no. LeBron James, Anthony Davis, Dwight Howard, Alex Caruso, Rajon Rondo. Are you kidding me?

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva and Theo Pinson review the 2013 Miami Heat roster
quotes.excerpt: We got Joel Anthony, Rashard Lewis, Udonis Haslem, James Jones, Norris Cole, Chris Anderson, Mike Miller, Shane Battier.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: We got Joel Anthony, Rashard Lewis, Udonis Haslem, James Jones, Norris Cole, Chris Anderson, Mike Miller, Shane Battier, Mario Chalmers, Ray Allen, Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, LeBron James.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Shane Battier could have started. Mike Miller could have started.
